importantNote: Removed zoom constraint to eliminate side column gaps, enforcing 100% full screen width dark mode coverage.

changelog.category: Zero Gap Fix & Full Screen Coverage (v1.7.8)
items: Removed CSS zoom property scaling that caused the 8% side column gap on mobile viewports.
Enforced 100% width and 100% viewport coverage across html, body, and liquid background canvas.
Guaranteed default dark theme background seamlessly fills the entire display edge-to-edge.
Bumped service worker cache version to v115.
